caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden statue of a standing figure, possibly female, with long dark hair and medium brown skin. The figure is adorned with a headdress featuring several tall, curved feathers in shades of yellow, red, and brown. The figure wears a knee-length dress or tunic that is a light tan color, fringed at the hem and sleeves, along with a cloak draped over the left shoulder. The cloak is predominantly red with dark blue and yellow borders. The figure's right arm is bent at the elbow with the hand brought to the waist, while the left arm hangs slightly forward. Around the figure's neck is a necklace or collar. The figure is standing on a rectangular, dark brown to gray wooden base, which is textured on the upper surface resembling cracked wood. The shoes are dark brown, with lighter socks visible above them. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Cigar Store Indian
